fusions.result: Concrete predecode shared-buffer MVC hook exists at the physical runtime boundary.
Position-aware global+coarse-grid Qwen descriptor is a stronger first spatial MVC baseline than token-order pooling.
FeatureEpoch becomes an explicit fail-closed compatibility contract, with field ablation required before relaxation.

Replacement question is reframed as function-by-function lineage: preserve early conditional compute, test Qwen reuse against original DINOv2 and 11-21M-class dedicated features, never delete OCR/localization/etc by aggregate caption success.
First v0.1 temporal comparator remains deterministic frame/tile change plus global anchor; learned pruning is a later candidate only if total-path measurements win.
Content-addressed frame/ROI evidence must be stored outside MTMD chunk metadata; MTMD/embedding identities become derived runtime receipts joined to the immutable source hash.
parallel=1 is the simplest baseline, not a fixed final setting; parallel>1 must earn inclusion under serialized Frank workload measurements.
